ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, two structural parts that are not connected to each other by an ordinary covalent bond can be seen; the upper part is a benzene ring connected to NH2, namely an aniline fragment. The lower part is a chain fragment containing a carbonyl group and a protonated enol oxygen: the left-end R2 is connected to the carbonyl carbon C(=O), the carbonyl carbon is then connected to a CH2, CH2 is connected to a carbon, this carbon bears an R1 substituent and forms a double bond with an oxygen that carries a positive charge and is connected to H. The curved arrow and dashed arrow in the figure are ignored according to the problem statement. Reasoning: The SMILES of the aniline fragment is written as Nc1ccccc1. In the lower fragment, both R2 and R1 are represented by the wildcard *, so from left to right it is R2-C(=O)-CH2-C(R1)=[OH+], corresponding to the SMILES *C(=O)CC(*)=[OH+]. The two fragments are not connected to each other, therefore they are connected with a dot, giving *C(=O)CC(*)=[OH+].Nc1ccccc1.

method.method_draft: First describe the visible structure, not the arrows: identify two disconnected components. Convert the aniline component, a phenyl ring bonded to NH2, to 'Nc1ccccc1'. Convert the carbonyl/enol component from left to right by replacing R2 and R1 with wildcard atoms: R2-C(=O)-CH2-C(R1)=[OH+], giving '*C(=O)CC(*)=[OH+]'. Join the two disconnected components with a dot to obtain '*C(=O)CC(*)=[OH+].Nc1ccccc1'.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中可见两个彼此未用普通共价键连接的结构部分；上方是一个苯环连接到 NH2，即苯胺片段。下方是一个含羰基和质子化烯醇氧的链状片段：左端 R2 连接到羰基碳 C(=O)，羰基碳再连接到一个 CH2，CH2 连接到一个碳，该碳带有 R1 取代基并与带正电且连有 H 的氧形成双键。图中的弯箭头和虚线箭头按题意忽略。推理：苯胺片段的 SMILES 写作 Nc1ccccc1。下方片段将 R2 和 R1 都用通配符 * 表示，则从左到右为 R2-C(=O)-CH2-C(R1)=[OH+]，对应 SMILES 为 *C(=O)CC(*)=[OH+]。两个片段互不相连，因此用点号连接，得到 *C(=O)CC(*)=[OH+].Nc1ccccc1。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the image as a chemical structure diagram: a benzene ring bearing an NH2 group, separate from a beta-dicarbonyl/enol-like fragment with R2 attached to a carbonyl carbon, a methylene linker, a carbon bearing R1, and a double bond to protonated oxygen OH+; ignore all curved and dashed arrows.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction to produce a SMILES expression and specifically to ignore the arrows in the transition-state drawing.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions: disconnected species are separated by '.', R-group placeholders can be represented by wildcard '*', benzene aniline is 'Nc1ccccc1', a carbonyl is 'C(=O)', and protonated hydroxyl double-bonded oxygen is represented as '=[OH+]'.
